findings.summary: xtask/shard-timings.txt is not among the reading's deliverables
findings.evidence: A change outside the listed deliverables widens the scope.

findings.summary: The code-extension list is a guess about what counts as code; it is not taken from anything the capability defines.
findings.evidence: `admit` (cap-study lib.rs:114-151) sets no rule on file types, and the conventions test in rules.rs checks the six required files, not which file types are banned. The list (rs, sh, py, js, ts, c, h, ...) is the test's own choice, so a study that adds a .h or .c sample would fail cargo test while the capability accepts it. The plan names this risk. Fix: In the test's doc comment and in the problem message, say that the list is the test's own definition of instance code, so a later study job can update one constant knowingly. Optionally keep the list to executable or build types (rs, sh, py, js, ts, Cargo.toml, build.rs) and drop c and h, which are more likely to show up as quoted source excerpts.

findings.summary: The instance-reference scan reads only the cap-study prompts and sources. The study briefs built elsewhere (athena-context briefs, athena-cli drain study_text) are not scanned.
findings.evidence: The 'reusable work lives in the studying capability' check covers crates/athena-cap-study/{src,prompts}. The plan's own dependents list names crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs (study_text) as a reader of studies/<id>/, but a hard-coded instance id there would not be caught. Fix: State this limit in the test's doc comment. Optionally, if a quick grep of crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs and crates/athena-context/src for `studies/firstmate-work-handling` comes back clean, add those files to the scanned sources.
findings.location: Plan step 3 / dependents entry 'capability sources scanned'

findings.summary: The criterion 6 demonstration runs `git diff --stat`, and not every role's copy has a git repository to run it in.
findings.evidence: System facts: readers, planner and critic get a plain copy without git. The producer has a one-commit git snapshot. The verifier's environment is not stated. Fix: Phrase the check as a comparison of the changed-path list with the base (the job's change list or diff), so it does not depend on a git command being available.

findings.summary: The mechanism string is long and carries the 'not covered' limit inside it, which other OLY entries put in the measure.
findings.evidence: Precedent OLY-B-A3-02 (learnings_recorded.rs:1-14) keeps the limits in the test's doc comment, and its mechanism names the test. Fix: Optional: shorten the mechanism to the three named mechanisms and move the 'fresh context and gap fix and re-check are not covered' clause into the measure, before `status: not shown`.

summary: The round-2 plan is ready to build. I checked its references against the snapshot. OLY-B-S1-02 is at docs/spec.toml:2928-2934, with mechanism "none" and measure "The spec gap list; status: requirement". `measure_problem` (hestia.rs:1219) accepts a measure ending in "status: not shown", and `spec_gaps` (hestia.rs:1291) treats "none" as a gap, so the spec-entry demonstrations fail before the change and pass after it. `StudyCapability::admit` is at cap-study lib.rs:114, and its nested-path test is at lib.rs:267. The conventions test is at rules.rs:1841. ci_shards.rs:411 compares the timings file with the workspace's test units, and its sibling line is shard-timings.txt:56. That makes the extra timings line a real need for criterion 5; Athena already raised it as a scope finding, so I do not repeat it. The cap-study tree is src/{lib,model,records,rules}.rs plus prompts/{producer,verifier}.md. A case-insensitive grep for firstmate or hermes there found nothing, so the real-file scan for instance references passes today. Matching only `studies/<id>` at an id boundary or the quoted `"<id>"` avoids the false positives a substring match would cause. The rule that flags code files no longer refuses layouts that admit accepts. Crate reach is respected: the test lives in athena-core and only cites the cap-study tests. The model, learnings_recorded.rs, has the exact helpers the plan copies (owner_problem, measure_label_problem, real_requirement, and the "none" companion test). I found only minor issues.
